title: Level 5 (World Class) - A-6
notes:
West leads the ♠7 against 4♥. West's spade lead is won by East. The defense continues spades and South must ruff the third round.

South plays a heart and East holds off. The second round of trumps is also allowed to hold. The 4-1 trump break threatens South's trump control. South must stop playing hearts. South's only chance is that East has 4423 distribution. South unblocks his top diamonds and plays 3 rounds of clubs. The ♦A is now played.

If East ruffs South overruffs and plays a club. East will get just his ♥A. If East discards so does South. Again East will get only the ♥A.
